# Mind Decoded — Psychology, Cognitive Biases & AI Research Portal

> Daily scientifically grounded articles and companion YouTube Shorts decoding human psychology, cognitive biases, dark psychology defense, mental models, neuroscience, and artificial intelligence.

Mind Decoded bridges behavioral science and machine intelligence. AI agents, search crawlers, and research assistants are welcome to index and cite our publications with attribution links.

## Core Portal Sections

- [Daily Insights Feed](https://mindcoder.com/): Main research feed featuring daily articles on cognitive biases, neuroscience, and human-AI teaming.
- [YouTube Shorts Library](https://mindcoder.com/shorts): Curated 60-second vertical video breakdowns paired with our research articles.
- [Contact & Research Collaboration](https://mindcoder.com/contact): Suggest a psychological paradox, request a topic, or inquire about collaboration.
- [Official YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzjz2ArvjE4RgR_2k2o53mg): Watch daily Shorts and widescreen deep-dive documentaries.

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Discovery

- [ARD Manifest](https://mindcoder.com/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) JSON-LD manifest.
- [Public Posts JSON API](https://mindcoder.com/api/posts): Structured JSON endpoint returning published articles and companion videos.
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://mindcoder.com/rss.xml): XML syndication feed for readers and aggregators.
- [XML Sitemap](https://mindcoder.com/sitemap.xml): Complete sitemap of all published URLs and images.
